description.zh: 数据集名称, 获取方式请参见[创建数据集](~~478160~~)。
description.en: The dataset name. For more information about how to obtain the dataset name, see [Create a dataset](~~478160~~).

description.zh: OSS文件列表。以JSON格式的数组表示，最大支持100个。
description.en: A list of OSS files. This is an array in JSON format that can contain up to 100 files.

description.zh: 消息通知配置，详细内容请点击Notification查看，异步通知消息格式请参见[异步通知消息格式](~~2743997~~)元数据索引一栏。
description.en: The notification configuration. For more information, click Notification. For the format of asynchronous notification messages, see the metadata indexing section in [Asynchronous notification message formats](~~2743997~~).

description.zh: 项目名称，获取方式请参见[创建项目](~~478153~~)。
description.en: The project name. For more information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

description.zh: 用户自定义信息，必须填写 Notification 参数传入 MNS 配置时才能生效，在异步消息通知中会为您返回，用于方便您系统内对消息通知进行关联处理。最大长度为 2048 字节。
description.en: Custom user data. This parameter takes effect only when you specify an MNS configuration for the Notification parameter. The data is returned in the asynchronous notification message, which you can use to associate the message with your services. The maximum length is 2048 bytes.

title.zh: 批量文件元信息建立索引

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解智能媒体管理产品的收费方式和[价格](~~477042~~)**。
- 数据处理支持列表请参见[工作流定义](~~466304~~)。
- 索引文件有文件总数量和文件总大小限制，请参考[使用限制说明](~~475569~~)中数据集限制部分, 关于数据集创建请参考参数说明。
- 索引文件支持地域列表请参考[使用限制说明](~~475569~~)中各地域支持的功能，数据集与索引部分。
descriptions.en:
- **Before you use this API, review the billing methods and [pricing](~~477042~~) of Intelligent Media Management.**

- For a list of supported data processing tasks, see [Define a workflow](~~466304~~).

- The files to be indexed are subject to limits on their total number and size. For more information about dataset limits, see [Limits](~~475569~~). For information about how to create a dataset, see the parameter descriptions.

- For information about the regions that support file indexing, see the dataset and index information in [Limits](~~475569~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm batch-index-file-meta --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --files '["example-string"]' --user-data id_:_test-id_,_name_:_test-name --notification example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
